title: Typed schema replay and rate-limited backoff tests
creator: Anya Patel
description: Goal: validate JSON mode enforcement under realistic production failure modes combined with interleaved tool/function calls and rate-limited downstream backoffs. This ticket exercises the constrained decoder and schema adherence when: (1) the model emits partial JSON across streaming chunks; (2) a tool call is interleaved and returns delayed or truncated data; (3) the serving runtime applies token-level rate limits or backpressure; and (4) fallback model variants are used. The intent is to catch regressions that cause unparseable payloads, silent schema drift, or incorrect fallback signatures.
acceptance_criteria: 1) End-to-end harness reproduces at least three failure scenarios (delayed tool response, truncated stream, backoff induced token drops) and asserts schema validity of final reassembled payload. 2) Telemetry captures token-level boundary events, tool-call correlation IDs, and backoff incidents. 3) A minimal repair strategy (retry-attempts, sentinel injection, or deterministic gap-filling) is validated for correctness and does not increase latency SLO misses by >5%. 4) Tests are wired into CI and flagged as flaky if >1% of runs fail nondeterministically.
test_plan:
- Build synthetic runner that simulates: slow tool RPCs (50ms-2s), truncated chunk delivery (random drop of 1-4 bytes at chunk edges), and token emission pauses (backoff events).
- Create 12 seed prompts exercising nested objects and arrays (including optional fields and union types).
- Run cross-model matrix: small/open models (gpt-lite-1), mid/quantized variants, and fallback safety model.
- For each run capture: raw token stream, reassembled buffer, decoder error logs, schema validator output (jsonschema), and runtime backoff traces.
- Automate scoring: pass/fail on schema compliance, plus secondary checks for extraneous keys and type mismatches.
- Add end-to-end smoke in nightly CI with reduced seeds to spot regressions early.
test_matrix: models: [gpt-lite-1, gpt-medium-q4, safety-fallback-1]; modes: [streaming-enabled, streaming-with-toolcall, streaming-with-backoff]; seeds: 12 prompts; failures: [delayed-tool, truncated-chunk, token-drop, sentinel-corruption]; validators: [jsonschema-strict, relaxed-checker]; CI cadence: nightly + pre-merge smoke

risks_and_mitigation:
Risk: Test nondeterminism due to model sampling and network timing. Mitigation: use temperature=0 and fixed seeds where possible; deterministic tokenizers in harness; replay recorded streams for deterministic variant.
Risk: Flaky CI because long-running scenarios. Mitigation: isolate long scenarios to nightly and keep pre-merge smoke minimal.
Risk: Repair strategies could mask upstream regressions. Mitigation: make repair behavior opt-in and telemetry-labeled so incidents remain visible.
implementation_notes:
- Reuse existing constrained-decoder harness but extend to support injected backoff events and chunk-truncation.
- Add metadata headers in streams to carry tool-call correlation id (X-Tool-Call-ID) and backoff markers.
- Use jsonschema v7 strict mode for pass criteria; implement tolerant postprocessing for repair experiments.
- Instrument runtime to emit token-boundary events to trace service-level backpressure interactions.
